page_title: UDI 0-3 ACM | Udinese v AC Milan 20/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Udinese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+2' What a miss! Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

88' Lennon Miller (Udinese) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Pietro Terracciano, who pulls off a comfortable save!
87' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
87' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) takes a short corner kick.

86' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for AC Milan.
85' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
84' The resulting corner from Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
84' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. AC Milan win a corner.
83' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
81' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Arthur Atta will be replaced by Lennon Miller (Udinese).
81' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Luka Modric walks off the pitch to be replaced by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan).

80' Razvan Sava pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom right corner.
78' Arthur Atta (Udinese) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Pietro Terracciano easily deals with the threat.
78' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
75' Arthur Atta (Udinese) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
72' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Doveri no option but to blow his whistle.
68' Marco Landucci has decided to make a change. Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) replaces Youssouf Fofana.
68' We are about to witness a substitution. Koni De Winter (AC Milan) is replacing Strahinja Pavlovic.
65' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
65' A clever short pass gives Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
63' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christian Pulisic trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan).
62' Rui Modesto (Udinese) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
62' Marco Landucci prepares a substitution. Santiago Tomas Gimenez is replaced by Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan).
59' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rui Modesto (Udinese) replacing Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
59' Here is a change. Keinan Davis is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese).
59' That will be all from Kingsley Ehizibue who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese).
56' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
56' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

53' 0 - 3 Goal! Adrien Rabiot manages to prod the ball to Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
50' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Jordan Zemura (Udinese) for his blatant foul.
46' 0 - 2 Goal! Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Kosta Runjaic probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Iker Bravo. He is replaced by Adam Buksa (Udinese).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The resulting free kick from Oier Zarraga (Udinese) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle as Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Keinan Davis (Udinese) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
42' It looks like Iker Bravo (Udinese) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Doveri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
40' 0 - 1 Goal! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
37' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends a killer pass through the opponent's defence in an effort to find a space for Santiago Tomas Gimenez, who is lurking close to the offside line.
35' Iker Bravo (Udinese) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
35' Udinese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
32' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
31' The referee awards a corner and Luka Modric (AC Milan) goes over to take it.
31' Luka Modric (AC Milan) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arthur Atta (Udinese) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

30' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
28' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
25' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for an infringement.
22' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
19' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Razvan Sava pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
18' Good clearance! Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
16' It seemed like Luka Modric (AC Milan) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
15' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle. Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) commits a foul after dangerous play.
12' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
11' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
10' The game is interrupted. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
9' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Pietro Terracciano intercepts the ball.
8' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
6' Daniele Doveri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Thomas Kristensen (Udinese).
3' Luka Modric (AC Milan) works the corner short.

3' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Razvan Sava pulls off a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AC Milan.
3' That's unlucky! Iker Bravo (Udinese) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
2' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
